ModMetaData.name: Living Landscapes
ModMetaData.author: Leif Christensen
ModMetaData.description: Brings geological and biological rules to map generation: terrain shaped by rock and erosion, rivers that run downhill and lay down floodplains, bars and deltas, cliffs, a sensible start spot and ore, and plants that grow where they would in nature (clustered, near water, in or out of the forest shade).
